correctness.rationale: For semiregular unital R, idempotents lift modulo J(R), with R/J regular. Perspectivity eR~p fR is equivalent to a right-left-right idempotent chain, and Khurana–Mittal Lemma 2.5 lifts such a chain through ideals in J(R). If quotient has PSB, reducing mutually subperspective summands gives quotient PSB and the terminal rlr chain lifts back. Conversely if R has PSB, start with arbitrary mutually subperspective quotient summands, express the two nested summands by finite orthogonal idempotent decompositions and lift those compatible decompositions (semiregularity). The two quotient rlr chains lift by Lemma 2.5, giving mutually subperspective summands upstairs; PSB in R yields a chain whose reduction gives quotient perspectivity. The required compatibility and exact semiregularity scope were checked. No computational certificate is used or needed.

The reverse direction from ring PSB alone and the resulting iff are not explicitly present in the read full HTML. The reverse transfer lifts *nested* quotient summands, not merely final isomorphisms, and removes the stronger ordinary SB assumption of prior theorem. Value does not rest on a finite case or nominal rephrasing.
